figurative_meaning_en: reduplicative expression; repeated tearing or shredding
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পুরনো কাপড়টা ছিঁড়াছিঁড়ি হয়ে গেছে।
তুমি কতবার আর এই বিষয়টা ছিঁড়াছিঁড়ি করবে?
example_sentences_in_english: This old cloth has become all torn and tattered.
How many more times will you keep tearing this issue apart?
note: This is a reduplicative form emphasizing repetition in Bengali linguistic patterns.
